description: Undo/redo history for a single wireframe editor instance. Not a DI service. TmWireframeEditor creates one instance and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue. Each editor on the page gets its own isolated stack.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears both stacks (e.g. after loading a new document).

members.name: Push
members.description: Executes command and pushes it onto the undo stack. Clears the redo stack. Move coalescing: if the previous command is a MoveElementsCommand targeting the same element ids and was pushed within 100 ms, the new command is merged into it (keeps the original "before" positions, updates "after").

members.name: Redo
members.description: Re-applies the most recently undone command. No-op if stack is empty.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Reverses the most recent command. No-op if stack is empty.
